newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mount Edon says accept higher offer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mount Edon says accept higher offer.

text.p: Mount Edon Gold Mines (Australia) Ltd said on Tuesday that Camelot Resources NL and Canada's Teck Corp had increased their takeover offer for Mount Edon to A$2.25 per share from A$2.15 per share.
Mt Edon said its board had decided to unanimously recommend shareholders accept the increased offer.
The increased offer was dependent on Camelot and Teck Corp receiving acceptances for 90 percent of Mount Edon's shares within three weeks of the offer being dispatched.
The price increase was also subject to the necessary approvals from the Australian Securities Commission (ASC).
Last month, Mount Edon said the original offer was opportunistic and advised shareholders to take no immediate action.
The Camelot-Teck offer values Mount Edon at A$165 million.
Mount Edon's share price closed three cents lower at A$2.11.
